set.body: Full private production journey native save and querytable pass. Actual map readiness fails: both density requests exist but TrialView inputs absent, statusEmpty; panels report ContentError.NotServed for query and matched reference. StudioWindow builds CompareSummaryHost with default PanelSources.notServed even when nativeSources is present; Explore has the real backend/display adapter. Add native session/display/stimulus adapter and wire it into real windows while retaining explicit story injection. Preserve fractional backend timing in portable content rather than narrowing Double ms to Int. Synthetic regression must draw both maps through ordinary production route; private full journey then repeats save/reopen/export. Initial map-requested.png and diagnostics retained privately.
